title: Phonemos
description: Connect YouTrack Helpdesk to a Phonemos knowledge base. OAuth settings are global; the search root can differ per project.

phonemosBaseUrl.title: Phonemos base URL
phonemosBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Phonemos instance, e.g. https://wiki.example.com

oauthClientId.title: OAuth client ID
oauthClientId.description: Confidential Keycloak client ID registered for this YouTrack app

oauthClientSecret.title: OAuth client secret
oauthClientSecret.description: Confidential Keycloak client secret. Stored as a YouTrack secret (not readable in the UI after save). Paste the full secret once and save; the app sends it only via HTTP Basic to the token endpoint.

oauthRedirectUri.title: OAuth redirect URI
oauthRedirectUri.description: Optional fallback. Prefer the URL shown under Connect (…/api/appResources/{id}/widgets/oauth-popup-callback.html). In Keycloak allow that URL or https://{youtrack}/api/appResources/*

oauthScope.title: OAuth scopes
oauthScope.description: Space-separated Keycloak scopes. Must include hasura so the access token carries Phonemos/Hasura claims. Assign the hasura client scope as Default on the Keycloak client.

withinObjectId.title: Phonemos search root
withinObjectId.description: Object UUID, 22-char slug, or topic URL to search within (e.g. https://showcase.phonemos.cloud/t/hgZU0Gy-S5ObkiUPdABgrQ/start). The app converts URLs/slugs to a UUID for the API.

searchLimit.title: Max suggestions
searchLimit.description: Maximum number of suggested articles to return
